# GST Validator MCP

> Verhoeff-checksum GSTIN validator with state + embedded-PAN extraction

This MCP server exposes 3 tools via the Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST). It runs on Cloudflare Workers and is billed via Dodo Payments. Authenticated via `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` obtained by subscribing at `https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade`.

## Endpoint
- MCP JSON-RPC: https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/mcp
- Health: https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/health
- Landing page: https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/
- Get API key: https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade?tier=solo

## Tools
- `validate_gstin`: Validate a GSTIN: length, charset, state code, embedded PAN, mod-36 check. Returns {ok, reason?}.
- `extract_pan`: Extract the 10-character PAN embedded in a GSTIN (positions 3-12).
- `state_from_gstin`: Resolve state/UT from the first 2 characters of a GSTIN. {state_code, state_name}.

## Authentication
Pass `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on POST /mcp. Free tier: anonymous, 100 calls / month / IP.

## Pricing
- Free: 100 calls / month (anonymous, no signup)
- Solo $9/mo: 2,000 calls / month, 60/min
- Team $29/mo: 10,000 calls / month, 200/min, 5 team seats
- Pro $79/mo: 50,000 calls / month, 600/min, 25 team seats
Billed via Dodo Payments (merchant-of-record). Cancel anytime.

## Account management
- View account: GET https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account (Bearer)
- Rotate key: POST https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/rotate (Bearer)
- GDPR data export: GET https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/export (Bearer)
- Team management (Team+): https://gst-validator-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/team
